## Evidence

- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] Failure and disposal behavior tested
- [ ] Reduced Motion and Power Save behavior tested where applicable
- [ ] Performance evidence included for hot-path changes
- [ ] `check`, project configuration, and structure verification pass
- [ ] Plugin Verifier passes when compatibility/API scope changes
- [ ] Traceability matrix updated

## Safety review

- [ ] No internal/implementation API, reflection, UI interception, or IDE-file modification
- [ ] No unbounded state, idle polling, or per-effect scheduler
- [ ] No sensitive data in logs/diagnostics
- [ ] Unsupported surfaces fail closed

## Screenshots or recordings

For visual changes, attach real before/after evidence and state the IDE build, OS, theme, scale, and profile.
